source: GitHub GraphQL API reference: Issue, IssueComment, AssignedEvent, RenamedTitleEvent, UserContentEdit, IssueTimelineItemsConnection (https://docs.github.com/en/graphql/reference/objects#issue) via POST https://api.github.com/graphql

json.query: query($owner:String!,$name:String!,$number:Int!){repository(owner:$owner,name:$name){issue(number:$number){id databaseId number title body state createdAt author{login} lastEditedAt userContentEdits(first:100){totalCount pageInfo{hasNextPage} nodes{id editedAt editor{login}}} assignees(first:20){nodes{login}} timelineItems(first:100, itemTypes:[ASSIGNED_EVENT, ISSUE_COMMENT, RENAMED_TITLE_EVENT]){totalCount pageInfo{hasNextPage} nodes{__typename ... on AssignedEvent{id createdAt actor{login} assignee{... on User{login} ... on Bot{login}}} ... on IssueComment{id createdAt author{login} body lastEditedAt userContentEdits(first:100){totalCount pageInfo{hasNextPage} nodes{id editedAt editor{login}}}} ... on RenamedTitleEvent{id createdAt actor{login}}}}}}}
